items.scene: One pizza and one banana milkshake, please. We haven't got much food now. Sorry, it's late. Have you got tomatoes? No, sorry. We haven't got tomatoes now. Have you got chicken? Or what about olives? No, we haven't got chicken. And we haven't got olives. You're too late. Oh no! And my milkshake? Have you got bananas? Yes, we've got lots of bananas. Oh good!
